On Tue, Mar 24, 2020 at 7:14 AM Leonardo Matheus Servino <leonardo...@gmail.com> wrote:

---------- Forwarded message ---------
De: Leonardo Matheus Servino <leonardo...@gmail.com>
Date: sáb, 21 de mar de 2020 15:05
Subject: Distance matrix construction and inputs
To: <mat...@nimbios.org>


Hello, Nicholas

I'm using the BioGeoBEARS, and I have some doubts. I would like to use a Distance matrix, this distance would be between the centroides of each area that I determined. How to construct this matrix and where I insert the file away in the script?

Example files are here:
http://phylo.wikidot.com/biogeobears#links_to_files

Discussion of the "+x" (adding distance as a predictor of dispersal probability) model:
http://phylo.wikidot.com/biogeobears#july2014

To change the script, 

(1) Un-comment this line, make the filename refer to your distances file:

#BioGeoBEARS_run_object$distsfn = "distances_matrix.txt"

(2) Turn on the "x" parameter by adding something like this to each model you want to be +x:

# Add distance-dependent dispersal (+x)
BioGeoBEARS_run_object$BioGeoBEARS_model_object@params_table["x","type"] = "free"
BioGeoBEARS_run_object$BioGeoBEARS_model_object@params_table["x","init"] = 0.0
BioGeoBEARS_run_object$BioGeoBEARS_model_object@params_table["x","est"] = -0.00001
BioGeoBEARS_run_object$BioGeoBEARS_model_object@params_table["x","min"] = -5.0
BioGeoBEARS_run_object$BioGeoBEARS_model_object@params_table["x","max"] = 0.0
 

Cheers!
Nick



Best wishes

Leonardo
